quickStart: If this is a medical emergency, call 911 immediately
Locate your downloaded ZIP file (usually in Downloads folder)
Extract all files to a secure location (right-click > Extract All)
Open PDF files for quick reference without editing
Contact emergency contacts listed in your data
Keep all documents secure - share only with trusted individuals

Personal Details.description: Core identity information required for all legal, medical, and financial processes.
firstActions: Verify all identity documents (SSN, Passport, Driver's License) are current
Ensure contact information is up to date
Confirm blood type with medical records if unknown
Notify healthcare providers if medical emergency

Emergency contact details.description: Primary and secondary contacts who should be notified in case of emergency.
firstActions: Contact primary emergency contact immediately
Verify contact information is current for all listed contacts
Ensure contacts are aware they are listed as emergency contacts
Update contact information if any changes have occurred

Insurance details.description: Health, life, and other insurance policies that may need to be activated or claimed.
firstActions: Locate original policy documents
Contact insurance company's emergency claims line
Verify policy is active and premiums are current
Understand coverage limits and claim procedures
Keep policy numbers readily accessible

Bank details.description: Financial accounts requiring immediate attention or access during emergencies.
firstActions: Contact bank to freeze accounts if necessary
Verify account holders and beneficiaries
Locate physical bank statements and documents
Contact banks to understand next steps for account access
Ensure authorized signers have proper documentation

IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS LOCATION.description: Physical location of critical legal and financial documents.
firstActions: Locate and secure all original documents immediately
Verify will is current and legally valid
Contact attorney if legal guidance needed
Gather all documents listed in this section
Store copies in multiple secure locations

Additional details.description: Supplementary information, special instructions, or unique circumstances.
firstActions: Read through all additional notes carefully
Follow any specific instructions provided
Share relevant information with appropriate parties

legalNotes: This guide provides general emergency access information only
Consult qualified attorneys for estate planning and legal matters
Verify compliance with state-specific regulations in your jurisdiction
Update this information at least annually or when circumstances change
Consider registering your will and other legal documents with appropriate authorities
This is not a substitute for proper legal documentation (wills, trusts, POAs)
Work with financial advisors for beneficiary designations on all accounts
Ensure healthcare directives and living wills are properly executed

fileStructure: Your emergency kit is packaged as a single ZIP file
Excel Workbook (.xlsx) - Editable spreadsheet with all your information
PDF Documents - Read-only files for easy printing and sharing
This Access Guide - Complete instructions for using your emergency kit
All files are password-protected for your security (if enabled)
dataAccess: Windows: Right-click ZIP file > Extract All
Mac: Double-click ZIP file to extract automatically
Save extracted files to a memorable, secure location
Consider encrypted cloud backup (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive)
Enable password protection on folders containing sensitive data
Share access credentials with at least one trusted person
Keep digital copies on secure devices (encrypted USB, password-protected phone)
securityTips: Never store passwords in plain text files
Share complete documents only via encrypted channels
Avoid sending sensitive information via regular email
Use secure messaging apps (Signal, WhatsApp) for sharing
Securely delete old versions (use file shredding software)
Enable two-factor authentication on all cloud storage
Consider professional document storage services for originals
Maintain both physical and digital copies in separate locations
